theater: 波斯灣沿岸與荷姆茲海峽

battle.name: 英國-波斯戰爭
battle.theater: 波斯灣沿岸與荷姆茲海峽
battle.brief: 一八五六年波斯使節在君士坦丁堡失言，英國與波斯絕交；同年十二月皇家海軍封鎖波斯灣，在布什爾外海開火。一八五七年英軍登陸基什島、攻陷荷姆茲石堡，並在海上截獲波斯巡防艦。雷管步槍這一代技術以法國一八四〇年制式為代表，已是遠征軍標準槍械，海霧中的遠射也讓密集隊形難以維持。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩邊，一邊是英國及其東印度公司，另一邊是卡扎王朝的波斯，而且是一場英方拉攏盟友、俄方支援對手的代理人戰爭。英方最高決策在倫敦：帕麥斯頓領銜的內閣掌外務，東印度公司孟買總督府出錢出人出船，皇家海軍的東印度與中國分遣隊抽出分隊參戰。陸軍方面組建波斯灣遠征軍，一八五六年底由陸軍中將詹姆斯·坎貝爾統一指揮，兵分第三師——由布萊杰少將領，轄第三十團、第三十一團與來福槍營第一營——與第四師——由戈登少將領，轄來福槍營第二營、第六十四團與第五十七團西印度團——另配工兵營、海軍陸戰隊分遣隊與野戰砲兵。坎貝爾任內節制失當，五月由波洛克中將接任。奧斯曼帝國自成一翼，從伊拉克方向在東境與英軍夾擊波斯；法國與撒丁王國各遣艦隊駛入地中海，法國海軍統帥拿破崙·拿皮爾揚言以大軍直取君士坦丁堡，實際效果是切斷波斯通往黑海的一切外援。波斯一方是國家機器加地方武力的鬆散聯盟：納西爾丁沙坐鎮德黑蘭，御前掌權的米爾扎·阿迦汗以「擁護王權派」之首自居，御前新軍「尼讚」按歐洲操典操練，保守的什葉派教士組成「擁護清真寺派」與之對立；南線由法爾斯總督米爾扎·馬赫迪汗率部把守海灣港口，並以法爾斯、荷姆茲、拉雷斯丹各省的部落民兵與徵召兵充當主力。海灣方向的波斯海軍只有一艘新式蒸汽巡防艦和數艘舊式帆船，另有英國在印度與本土之間的海運線和電報線，替遠征軍維持耳目。
countriesEn: The two sides were Britain together with the East India Company on one hand, and Qajar Persia on the other, and the war was fought as a proxy struggle in which Britain drew in allies while Russia supported the opposing camp. British policy was decided in London: a cabinet under Palmerston in charge of foreign affairs, the Bombay Presidency of the East India Company supplying the money, the men, the arms and the shipping, and the Royal Navy's East Indies and China squadrons detaching ships for the Gulf. On land the force raised was the Persian Gulf expeditionary army, formed at the end of 1856 under Lieutenant-General Sir James Campbell, divided into the 3rd Division under Brigadier-General Fraser, with the 30th and 31st Regiments of Foot and the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade, and the 4th Division under Brigadier-General Gordon, with the 2nd Battalion of the Rifle Brigade, the 64th Regiment of Foot and the 57th (West India) Regiment; engineers, a naval brigade and field artillery completed the order of battle. Campbell was judged to have handled the force badly and was relieved in May by Lieutenant-General Pollock. The Ottoman Empire formed a second front, pressing Persia on the eastern border from Iraq while the Royal Navy worked the Gulf; France and Sardinia sent squadrons into the Mediterranean, where the French commander Charles Napier openly talked of marching a great army on Constantinople, and the practical result was that Persia's access to the Black Sea was cut off. The Persian side was a loose combination of state and local levies: Naser al-Din Shah sat in Tehran, Mirza Agha Khan Nouri headed the Supporters of the Crown at court, the new imperial troops known as the Nizam were drilled on European lines, and the conservative Shiite clergy organised as the Supporters of the Mosque faced them across the palace. The southern line was held by Mirza Mahdi Khan, Governor of Fars, with tribal levies and conscripts drawn from Fars, Hormuz and Larestan doing most of the actual fighting. Persia had a single modern steam frigate in the Gulf and a handful of old sailing vessels, while Britain's shipping route between India and England and the telegraph lines gave the expedition its eyes and ears.
people: 英方最關鍵的決策者是帕麥斯頓，他在克里米亞和約之後仍主張對波斯施壓，並以東印度與英國的海上力量執行。坎貝爾中將以遠征軍總指揮身份接手一支缺乏熱帶經驗的部隊，他主張封鎖海灣、以艦炮壓制岸防，但自一八五七年二月登陸基什島起推進緩慢，屢遭催促，五月被波洛克中將撤換。真正在戰場上改變節奏的是布萊杰少將與戈登少將：戈登率來福槍營第二營與第六十四團，堅持在荷姆茲強行登陸，砲擊石堡後不等守軍投降便下令突擊，一舉奪堡並俘虜約八百人；隨後撤退時他又未能替後衛安排退路，來福槍營第一營在清晨被波斯援軍截斷，幾乎全軍覆沒，成為整場戰爭最慘重的部隊損失。戈登的進取作風與善後失誤，此後在英國陸軍內部長期受到非議。波斯方面，國王納西爾丁沙表現克制，主戰的是御前米爾扎·阿迦汗；他出身「擁護王權派」，正是他的人馬在君士坦丁堡挑起事端，卻又在英軍逼近時準備割地求和。駐君士坦丁堡大使米爾扎·穆罕默德·阿里汗因向蘇丹與新任外相當面羞辱，成為整場危機的導火線；事後他被奧斯曼當局拘押驅逐，成為雙方絕裂的表徵。已故首席大臣阿米爾·卡比爾在一八五二年遇刺，他所推行的改革與他建立的新軍體系，正是波斯能拿現代化部隊應戰的前提，他死後名字被波斯海軍用來命名被英軍俘獲的巡防艦。波斯南線的實際指揮是法爾斯總督米爾扎·馬赫迪汗，他以拖延與游擊應對英軍登陸，最終在守軍潰散、後方失去支援的形勢下被迫求和。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the British side was Palmerston, who pressed for pressure on Persia even after the Crimean peace and saw to its execution through India and the sea power of the Royal Navy. Lieutenant-General Sir James Campbell took over the Persian Gulf expeditionary force with a staff unused to campaigning in the tropics. He favoured a blockade and naval gunfire against the shore defences, but from the landing on the island of Qishm in February 1857 his advance stalled, he was pressed from London, and in May he was replaced by Lieutenant-General Sir George Pollock. The officers who actually changed the pace on the ground were Brigadier-General Fraser and Brigadier-General Charles George Gordon. Gordon, commanding the 2nd Battalion of the Rifle Brigade and the 64th Foot, insisted on forcing the landing at Hormuz, ordered the assault before the garrison had surrendered after the bombardment, took the fort in a single rush and took some eight hundred prisoners; in the withdrawal he then failed to arrange a road for the rear guard, and the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade was cut off by Persian reinforcements at daybreak and very nearly annihilated, the heaviest loss of any unit in the war. Gordon's aggressiveness and his failure of command in the withdrawal were both argued over inside the British army for years afterwards. On the Persian side the Shah was cautious, and the driving figure was Mirza Agha Khan at court, who headed the Supporters of the Crown; it was his agents who set the affair going in Constantinople, and he was ready to make concessions once the British advanced. Mirza Mohammad Ali Khan, the ambassador in Constantinople, who had openly humiliated the Sultan and the new foreign minister, became the spark of the whole crisis, and the Ottoman authorities afterwards arrested and expelled him with his suite, an act that became the visible sign of the rupture. The late vizier Amir Kabir, assassinated in 1852, had created the reformed services that made it possible for Persia to fight with modern troops at all, and his name was later given to the Persian frigate the British captured at sea. Practical command of the southern front lay with Mirza Mahdi Khan, Governor of Fars, who answered the landings with delays and counter-attacks until his troops scattered and his rear lost all support.
kits: 這張卡上的雷管步槍，指的是一八四〇年前後定型的雷管槍族：法國一八四〇年制式步槍及其步槍型是這一技術世代的樣板，圓膛改成節膛、加長槍管、配上銅質雷管，射程與精度都遠勝火燧槍；英國的布倫斯堡與後來的恩菲爾德一八五三年步槍屬於同一族。遠征軍的步兵線上用的正是這一代槍：恩菲爾德一八五三年步槍口徑為零點五八英寸，配重彈的長槍型有效射程可達數百碼，近者更及八百至一千碼；一八五六年前後英軍亦把大量舊式圓膛步槍改膛成步槍，使步兵普遍擁有節膛槍。每名步兵攜帶約六十發紙殼定裝槍藥，營部有備份彈藥車。波斯灣的霧氣與烈日，正是雷管底火相對不受潮濕影響的實戰理由：火燧槍遇濕即啞，雷管槍在海霧裡仍能擊發，而遠射精度也讓傳統密集縱隊難以維持。波斯方面，尼讚新軍裝備一部分奧地利製步槍與英國、德國進口的雷管圓膛槍，舊部仍留有火燧槍；波斯火炮以四磅與六磅口徑的生鐵滑膛炮為主，另有少量膛線炮。海軍的蒸汽巡防艦 Amir Kabir 裝兩門六十八磅級重炮，鐵質船殼下裝蒸汽機。運載方面，英軍用駱駝與牛隻搬運彈藥與糧食，商船與汽船自孟買運來煤、糧食與軍需。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card belongs to the family of weapons standardised around 1840. The French Model 1840 musket and its rifle pattern were the templates of the technical generation, with rifled barrels, greater length and a brass percussion cap, all of which gave range and accuracy far beyond the flintlock; the British Brunswick and the later Enfield Pattern 1853 belonged to the same family. The rifle line the expedition put ashore was exactly of this generation: the Enfield Pattern 1853 musket used a .58 inch bore, the long rifle pattern with its heavy bullet reached several hundred yards and in some cases close to a thousand, and in 1855-56 the British converted large numbers of older round-bore muskets to rifled barrels, so that rifle weapons were common throughout the infantry line. Each infantryman carried about sixty rounds of paper-cased fixed ammunition, with brigade reserve ammunition wagons behind. The humidity and salt haze of the Gulf were precisely the argument for the percussion cap: a flintlock went silent when it got wet, while a percussion gun still went off in the sea mist, and the accuracy at long range broke up the old close-order column. On the Persian side the Nizam troops carried a mixture of Austrian rifles and British and German-made percussion round-bores, with flintlocks still in service among the older units; Persian artillery consisted mainly of iron smooth-bore guns of four and six pounds, with a few rifled pieces besides. The steam frigate Amir Kabir carried two heavy guns of the 68-pounder class on an iron hull driven by steam machinery. On the logistics side British baggage was moved by camel and bullock, while coal, provisions and ammunition came out of Bombay in steamers.
tactics: 英軍全程走的是海路封鎖加分隊登陸的節奏。一八五六年十二月三十日，波斯灣分遣隊在布什爾外海排成南北弧線，以艦炮隔水打擊城北炮台與岸防工事，一夜之間打到岸上炮位沉默；波斯守軍以岸炮與駁船回擊，但在射程與射界上都吃虧，月底雙方在布什爾立約停火，艦隊隨即改為封鎖全灣。英軍的戰役計畫是沿海岸由西向東切斷波斯南部：先以孟買為後勤基地，把兵員、彈藥、糧食和煤用商船運到海灣西口，再由艦隊護送師級部隊北運。一八五七年二月七日拂曉，趁海霧未散，來福槍營第一營與第三十團的先頭營在基什島北岸登陸，隨即以散兵線向島內鹽灘上的堡壘推進，步兵在堡壘與椰林之間交替掩護，把守島的波斯軍與民兵趕入村落，再由工兵接管島上電報站與碼頭設施。控制島嶼之後，遠征軍沿海島鏈北上，最後一段改為從海上直取荷姆茲：海軍陸戰隊分遣隊與第四師在艦炮掩護下登陸，先以攻城砲與艦炮壓低石堡火力，再趁夜潮水退盡由來福槍營第二營帶頭翻牆強登，守軍約八百人見勢投降。四月二十六日的海戰中，蒸汽巡防艦 Furious 以艦炮擊中波斯巡防艦 Amir Kabir 的舷側，對方起火後仍拒降，英軍接舷登艦奪船，艦上指揮官陣亡。撤退階段的部署最糟：英軍放棄荷姆茲，把海灣內的煤炭與淡水搬空，同時沒有替斷後部隊安排退路，來福槍營第一營在清晨遭波斯大隊包圍，短兵相接之下折損過半。整體而言，遠征軍靠艦炮射程與分隊登陸取勝，靠後勤分段的細節失分。
tacticsEn: The British campaign ran throughout on a rhythm of naval blockade and detached landings. On 30 December 1856 the Persian Gulf squadron took up a north-south crescent off Bushire and used its guns to strike the batteries north of the town and the shore works from beyond range of reply; within a night the shore batteries were silenced. The Persian garrison replied with the land guns and with boats, but was outgunned and outangled, and at the end of the month the two sides concluded a truce at Bushire, after which the squadron converted to a blockade of the whole Gulf. The British plan was to cut southern Persia off along the coast from west to east: Bombay served as the supply base, men, ammunition, provisions and coal moving by merchant ship to the western mouth of the Gulf, and the squadrons escorted divisional troops northward. On 7 February 1857, at first light and with the sea mist still on the water, the leading companies of the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade and the 30th Regiment landed on the north shore of the island of Qishm and pushed forward in skirmish order against the works on the salt flats, the infantry giving cover in turn between the redoubts and the palm groves and driving the Persian soldiers and militia back into the villages, after which engineers took over the island's telegraph station and harbour works. With the island secured the expedition moved north along the chain of islands, and the last stage was carried out from the sea against Hormuz: the naval brigade and the 4th Division landed under cover of the ship guns, the fort was first beaten down with siege guns and naval artillery, and at night, with the tide out, the 2nd Battalion of the Rifle Brigade went over the wall at the head of the assault, the garrison of some eight hundred surrendering once the position was turned. In the action of 26 April the steam frigate Furious put a shell into the side of the Persian frigate Amir Kabir, which burned but refused to surrender; the British closed and boarded her, and her commander was killed. The withdrawal was the worst laid-out part of the operation: the British abandoned Hormuz, stripped the coal and water out of the Gulf, and at the same time left the rear guard no road to fall back on, so that the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade was surrounded by a large Persian force at daybreak and lost more than half its strength in close fighting. In sum the expedition won through the reach of naval gunfire and landings made in divisions, and lost on the finer points of supply broken into stages.
data: 數字方面：遠征軍最終編制約六千至九千人，野戰砲約二十門，海軍陸戰隊分遣隊約一千人；由孟買到海灣的海上補給線長約一千五百至兩千公里，每一批補充都要靠印度蒸汽商船與英國東印度分遣隊的煤水維持。布什爾炮擊中，英方出動巡防艦與蒸汽艦六至八艘，艦炮數十門，歷時約一晝夜；波斯岸防守軍約千人。一八五七年二月七日基什島之戰，英軍投入約二千五百人，防守方的波斯軍與民兵約一千五百至二千人，英軍陣亡數十人、負傷百餘人；英軍其後再取島南端的暗堡與電報站，二月內完成全島控制。四月十九日遠征軍抵達荷姆茲島外，四月二十六日同時發生石堡強登與海上截擊，英軍在石堡俘虛約八百名守軍。撤退時來福槍營第一營出動約四百五十人，最後生還不足百人，死傷合計佔全營一半以上。封鎖由一八五六年十二月延續到一八五七年五月，約四至五個月；整場危機自一八五六年六月的外交事件起算，到一八五八年英國使團重返德黑蘭，前後約兩年。和約中波斯須支付以數萬鎊計的賠償，並放棄對赫拉特與梅爾夫的主張；遠征軍主力於一八五七年夏撤回印度，兩個師團陸續返回本土。
dataEn: On figures: the expeditionary force numbered roughly six to nine thousand men in the end, with about twenty field guns and a naval brigade of around a thousand; the sea supply line from Bombay to the Gulf ran some fifteen hundred to two thousand kilometres, and every resupply depended on the coal and water of the India steamers and of the East Indies squadron. In the bombardment of Bushire the British brought out six to eight frigates and steamers with several dozen guns, and the firing lasted roughly a round of the clock, against a shore garrison of about a thousand men. In the action on Qishm on 7 February 1857 the British put ashore some two thousand five hundred men against Persian regulars and militia numbering between one thousand five hundred and two thousand, and lost several dozen dead and over a hundred wounded; they afterwards took the outworks and the telegraph station at the south end of the island and had the whole of it under control within the month. The expedition reached the neighbourhood of Hormuz on 19 April, and on 26 April the storming of the fort and the action at sea happened on the same day, the British taking some eight hundred prisoners at the fort. In the withdrawal the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade went out with about four hundred and fifty men and returned with fewer than a hundred, more than half the battalion being killed or wounded. The blockade ran from December 1856 to May 1857, roughly four to five months; the whole crisis, from the diplomatic incident of June 1856 to the return of a British mission to Tehran in 1858, lasted about two years. Under the peace terms Persia had to pay compensation counted in tens of thousands of pounds and to abandon its claims on Herat and Merv, and the main body of the expeditionary force withdrew to India in the summer of 1857, the two divisions returning to England in due course.
cause: 導火線是一八五六年六月在君士坦丁堡的一次外交口角。克里米亞戰爭的《巴黎條約》於一八五六年三月三十日簽訂，條約要求蘇丹政府取締禁軍並推行改革，其附加議定書亦把改革條款延伸給其他簽約國；波斯的什葉派教士與保守派在德黑蘭反對改革，認為蘇丹式的中央集權與什葉派國家的宗教體制無法相容。駐君士坦丁堡的波斯大使米爾扎·穆罕默德·阿里汗在議事場合當面羞辱蘇丹阿卜杜勒·梅吉德一世與新任外相穆罕默德·阿里·福阿德帕夏，說出與英國競賽的挑釁話語；八月，奧斯曼當局拘押這位大使及其隨員並將他們逐出境內，波斯視之為對條約與當地特權的踐踏，兩國隨即斷絕往來。英國介入的理由有兩層。一是經濟與戰略的實際利益：一八五六年的英波商約剛在倫敦談成，英國在波斯灣的商路、煤站與未來的海上通道都靠這份條約與常駐使團維持，而一八五五年英國駐德黑蘭公使團已被撤離，英方擔心波斯倒向俄國並封閉通往英屬印度的航路。二是政策層面的介入慾望：「擁護王權派」的改革計畫與英國目標一致，英國想用一場可控的戰爭換取德黑蘭對英國人重新常駐與改革派掌權的同意。深層的背景是納西爾丁沙朝著北方與西北方擴張，一八五六年前後波斯攻入阿富汗的赫拉特，逼近英屬印度的西北邊界，英國擔心一個從陸路吞併赫拉特與梅爾夫的波斯會把勢力推到家門。此外，過去十年間英國在波斯扶植的改革派與阿米爾·卡比爾建立的新軍體系，正是波斯能夠拿出現代化部隊應戰的原因。
causeEn: The spark was a diplomatic incident at Constantinople in June 1856. The Treaty of Paris ending the Crimean War was signed on 30 March 1856 and required the Ottoman government to disband the Janissaries and carry out reforms, while its protocol extended those reform clauses to the other signatories. The Shiite clergy and the conservatives in Tehran opposed reform on the ground that a Sultan-style centralisation could not be reconciled with the religious constitution of a Shiite state. Mirza Mohammad Ali Khan, the Persian ambassador in Constantinople, openly humiliated the Sultan Abdülmecid and the new foreign minister Mehmed Ali Fuad Pasha in open session, with words about competing with the English; in August the Ottoman authorities arrested the ambassador and his suite and expelled them from the empire, and Persia treated that as a breach of the treaty and of the capitulations, after which relations were broken. British involvement had two layers. First were the practical commercial and strategic interests: the Anglo-Persian commercial treaty had just been negotiated in London in 1856, and Britain's trade, its coal depots and its future sea route in the Gulf depended on that treaty and on a resident mission, while the British legation at Tehran had already been withdrawn in 1855, leaving London apprehensive that Persia would turn towards Russia and close the shipping road to British India. Second was a policy appetite for intervention: the reform programme of the Supporters of the Crown matched British aims, and Britain wanted a controlled war that would buy the consent of Tehran to a renewed British mission and to the coming to power of the reformers. Underneath it all lay the Shah's expansion northward and northwestward: in and around 1856 Persia moved into Herat in Afghanistan, coming close to the northwest frontier of British India, and London feared that a Persia absorbing Herat and Merv by land would bring that power to the door. It should also be remembered that the reformers British patronage had sustained in Persia over the previous decade, and the new army created by Amir Kabir, were what made it possible for Persia to meet the war with modern troops at all.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是波斯灣的門戶被打開：荷姆茲與基什群島一度置於英國控制之下，波斯海軍唯一的新式巡防艦被俘，成為英國在海灣的警告。英國在波斯灣取得商路與據點之後，一八五八年重新派駐公使，翌年由米爾扎·馬爾卡姆汗率領使團赴德黑蘭，扶植受英方影響的改革派，德黑蘭在財政、關務與軍隊編制上逐步改制。這條主軸自此成形：英國要阻止任何勢力從陸路打通通向印度的通道，一八五七年加爾各答的孟加拉軍人起義與這條戰線的緊張直接相關，遠征軍的艦炮與攻城技術回到印度本土，士兵對被調往「越過印度河」的普遍不安，加上倫敦與加爾各答對遠征部隊歸屬的臨時改組，都加深了東印度公司的困境。從歐洲看，法國與撒丁的介入把英國與奧斯曼的關係推得更近，海峽的航權與未來的蘇伊士通道成為英國新的重心；俄國在裏海與高加索的活動被迫收縮，其在波斯的傳統影響力明顯退潮，波斯此後數十年轉而向俄國靠攏。對波斯本身，戰敗並沒有改變卡扎王朝的統治，卻讓改革派與保守派的權力天平擺向「擁護王權派」，也讓德黑蘭明白海峽的防衛是國防的一部分，而不是海軍的瑣事。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the war was that the door of the Persian Gulf was forced open. Hormuz and the Qishm islands came for a time under British control, and the only modern frigate in the Persian navy was captured to serve as a warning to Persia in the Gulf. Once Britain had established trade routes and footholds there it sent a minister back in 1858, and in the following year a mission headed by Mirza Malkam Khan went to Tehran to back the reformers, and there the ministries for finance, customs and military organisation were gradually reformed along British lines. That axis took shape from then on: Britain had to prevent any power from opening a land route to India, and the tension on this front was directly connected with the mutiny of the Bengal Army at Calcutta in 1857. The naval guns and siegecraft of the expedition had come home to India, the men were generally uneasy at being sent beyond the Indus, and the improvised rearrangement of the expedition's command in London and Calcutta deepened the difficulties of the East India Company. Seen from Europe, the entry of France and Sardinia pushed British and Ottoman relations closer together, and the rights of passage through the Straits and the future Suez route became the new focus of British policy; Russian activity in the Caspian and the Caucasus was forced to contract, Russian influence in Persia receded markedly, and Persia turned towards Russia for the following decades. For Persia itself the defeat changed nothing about Qajar rule, but it tipped the balance between reformers and conservatives towards the Supporters of the Crown, and it taught Tehran that the defence of the Straits was a part of national defence rather than a matter for the navy alone.
result: 戰果由英方全數拿到。一八五七年四月，波斯在德黑蘭與英方接觸，派使到加爾各答求和；五月，波斯南線部隊與海軍從英軍已經建立的封鎖線上全面退開，荷姆茲與基什群島上的英軍駐紮由作戰狀態轉入接收談判的狀態。和約的主要條款是：波斯承認一八五六年英波商約的效力，允許英國重新派駐公使，撤走在赫拉特與梅爾夫方向的波斯軍隊，支付以數萬鎊計的賠償；英國則沒有在波斯境內保留長期佔領，除保留島上的一個據點外，遠征軍於一八五七年夏開始撤回印度，兩個師團陸續返回本土，英軍在海灣只留下艦隊的長期存在。英軍在這場戰爭裡付出的代價集中在一處：荷姆茲撤退時來福槍營第一營幾乎全滅，這一營的教訓此後在英軍的撤退編組與後衛戰術中被反覆引用。對波斯而言，這是一場以海灣換安寧的敗仗：王朝保住，首都保住，尼讚新軍也保住了編制，御前改革派反而在戰後坐大，但海防與外交通道的代價要由下一代人來償還。
resultEn: The results went to Britain in full. In April 1857 Persia made contact in Tehran and sent an embassy to Calcutta to sue for peace; in May the Persian southern troops and navy withdrew all along the blockade line the British had already established, and the garrisons on Hormuz and the Qishm islands passed from a state of operations to one of taking possession for the peace settlement. The main terms were that Persia recognised the effect of the 1856 Anglo-Persian commercial treaty, allowed a British minister to return, withdrew its forces towards Herat and Merv, and paid compensation counted in tens of thousands of pounds. Britain in turn did not keep any lasting occupation in Persian territory: apart from retaining a single post on the island, the expeditionary force began to withdraw to India in the summer of 1857 and the two divisions went home in due course, the British presence in the Gulf thereafter resting on the long-term presence of the squadrons. The British cost in this war was concentrated in a single place: at the withdrawal from Hormuz the 1st Battalion of the Rifle Brigade was very nearly wiped out, and the lessons of that battalion were quoted again and again afterwards in the organisation of British withdrawals and rear guard work. For Persia it was a defeat that bought quiet at the price of the Gulf: the dynasty survived, the capital survived, the Nizam kept its establishment, and the pro-reform party at court actually grew stronger after the war, but the bill for the coastal defence and for the country's access to the sea fell to the next generation to pay.
